doc: <dl><dt data-c="">convert</dt><dd>Converts perf data file into another format. It’s possible to set data-convert debug variable to get debug messages from conversion, like: perf --debug data-convert data convert ...</dd></dl>

<dl><dt data-o="">--to-ctf</dt><dd>Triggers the CTF conversion, specify the path of CTF data directory.</dd></dl> <dl><dt data-o="">--to-json</dt><dd>Triggers JSON conversion. Specify the JSON filename to output.</dd></dl> <dl><dt data-o="">--tod</dt><dd>Convert time to wall clock time.</dd></dl> <dl><dt data-o="">-i</dt><dd>Specify input perf data file path.</dd></dl> <dl><dt data-o="">-f, --force</dt><dd>Don’t complain, do it.</dd></dl> <dl><dt data-o="">-v, --verbose</dt><dd>Be more verbose (show counter open errors, etc).</dd></dl> <dl><dt data-o="">--all</dt><dd>Convert all events, including non-sample events (comm, fork, ...), to output. Default is off, only convert samples.</dd></dl>
